purpose: Estimate the funding needed to complete the remaining 49 frozen Stage1 V6 development provider responses before any development reference opening or scoring.

notes: GPT-6 Sol Standard short-context rates are $2.00/M input, $0.20/M cached input, $2.50/M cache writes, and $10.00/M output; Flex is 50% of Standard.
Prompt cache writes are an alternative input-token billing category, not an additive fee on top of uncached input.
The Stage1 packets are far below the GPT-6 Sol long-context pricing threshold.

historicalUsageBasis.experiment: frozen complete Stage1 V5 generation set
historicalUsageBasis.reasonForUse: V6 reuses the exact frozen Stage1 Structure Evidence v2 packets and changes only the semantic contract, making V5 per-track provider usage the best available zero-cost distributional proxy.

sameTrackV5V6CanaryCalibration.qualification: One same-track comparison is calibration evidence only; it does not guarantee identical deltas across the remaining tracks.

remaining49Projection.method: V5 remaining49 historical-profile cost plus 49 times the observed same-track V6-minus-V5 canary cost delta
remaining49Projection.envelopeQualification: This is a conservative one-attempt output-cap envelope using the historical per-track V5 input/cache-write profile and 8192 output tokens for every remaining case; it is not a predicted bill.
remaining49Projection.retryPolicy: No retries are included or authorized. Any incomplete V6 response would remain incomplete and any later retry would require separate explicit authorization.
remaining49Projection.scientificImplication: A partial remaining49 run does not unlock development scoring; all 50 V6 development responses must be complete and frozen before Stage1 development references are opened.

prepaidBillingConstraint.note: This billing minimum is an account-funding constraint, not an experiment requirement. No credit purchase is authorized by this receipt.

conclusion: The best zero-cost estimate for completing the 49 remaining V6 development responses is approximately $1.84 at the frozen GPT-6 Sol/High/Flex/8192 contract, with a conservative one-attempt max-output envelope of approximately $2.85.
